title: Global search shows the badge next to the status
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Goodwill, in status Approved.
custom_steps: 1. Search for work order 1's number in global search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's result shows the "No Charge" badge next to its status.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R10: “The work orders list shows the badge in the status column for internal and no-charge work orders in every tab, in the Tech View display and on the mobile card. Open and closed internal and no-charge rows show "No Charge" in Total Price (the column exists only for users with 'See Financial Data'; others see the badge); closed ones show where invoiced ones show (the All tab, Status "Closed"), not in the Completed tab, which lists work waiting for an invoice. Board cards show the badge, and a closed internal or no-charge work order sits where an invoiced one sits on the Board. Schedule cards show the badge next to the work order number (the card shows no status text); global search results show it next to the status. The Status chip on the All tab gets the value "Closed", which matches only closed internal and no-charge work orders; Invoiced and Paid do not match them. The customer's and the asset's Work Orders tabs show the same badge.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
